About Progeni Bench

Browser-First Global Architecture

Progeni Bench is designed on a simple principle: digital utility tasks should be instant, free, and 100% private. All 30 tools process files locally in your web browser. Your sensitive spreadsheets, personal photos, and contact lists never touch an external server.

Progeni Bench is A Progeni project dedicated to building fast, zero-bloat web utilities.

Who is Progeni Bench Built For?

  • Crafters & Creators: Make sticker sheets, mirror T-shirt prints, create cross-stitch patterns, and test video safe zones.
  • Professionals & Marketers: Clean browser bookmarks, split large CSVs, deduplicate contact databases, and format vCards.
  • Everyday Power Users: Convert timetables to iCal, check subtitle reading speed, find duplicate photos, and optimize print layouts.
Progeni Bench — A Progeni project · Small file jobs, done privately in your browser.
